newsitem.title: USA: Alex. Brown Q2 investment banking down, M&A up.
newsitem.headline: Alex. Brown Q2 investment banking down, M&A up.

text.p: BALTIMORE, Md., July 17 ( Reuter) - Alex. Brown Inc said Thursday that its investment banking revenues fell 29 percent to $95.5 million in the second quarter, primarily due to diminished underwriting activity in the equity offerings market.
Merger and advisory revenues totaled $38.8 million in the period, up 66 percent from the $23.3 million in the second quarter of 1996.

The company reported second quarter primary and fully diluted earnings per share of $1.23 and $1.09, respectively, compared with primary and fully diluted earnings per share of $2.01 and $1.77 in the second quarter of 1996.
Current second quarter earnings included a charge related to severance costs which reduced primary and fully diluted earnings per share by $0.18 and $0.16, respectively.

The company said it would be holding a special meeting of shareholders on August 13 to consider a proposal to approve the merger agreement, announced in April, between Alex. Brown and Bankers Trust New York Corp.
